_comment: Project fidelity config for the GroupShortcutCard 3-row library on home (619:8194). Tolerances mirror account-states/dialog/cards. The harness renders 3 rows (677:4761/4762/4763), each in its own 350×87 canvas. The figma master uses placeholder text 'amount' / 'unit' inside the bottom row — impl renders the real formatted balance + currency, so we ignoreText those template tokens.
_ignoreTextNote: Figma master ships placeholder 'amount' / 'unit' in the bottom-row text frames. Impl renders the live formatted balance + currency code via the GroupShortcutCard props. Box / typography / color of these frames is still scored — only the text content is data-vs-template.

deviations.node: Account Balance Card · 账户余额卡片
deviations.reason: Outer drop-shadow alpha intentionally raised from figma's #000000@0.01 to #000000@0.06. The 0.01 token is effectively 'no shadow' on real iOS/Android pixel rounding (and reads flat in figma's raster export against the cream surface-subtle bg). Wave-4 user review flagged the three account cards as detached/borderless; 6% alpha + 12px blur restores the subtle elevation the design intent communicates while keeping the cards light against #F7F5EE. Captured as deviation rather than fixed in figma because the rest of the master's tokens (size/radius/padding/border/color/typography) all match — only the shadow alpha is an under-spec'd token.
